sources.reason: Fetched official CSV directly; parsed 370 data rows. Six matching entity records for five requested exchange brands.
Official register page identifies CASP CSV as authorised providers and displays last update 7 October 2026. ESMA warns that register publication can lag national registers.

note: EU is a regional MiCA register, not a national licence. National authorities grant authorisations; services and passport countries differ by entity. No matching requested-brand rows found for Binance, Bitget, HTX, CoinW or MEXC in this snapshot; absence is not proof of a ban. No fiat rail claims sourced. Preserve the separate Kraken entity service scopes; Payward Global Solutions Limited lists trading platform service only for CY and IE.
